title: The ContentPen WordPress plugin before 1.1.1 discloses its REST API key to unauthenticated users, who can then use it…
description: The ContentPen WordPress plugin versions before 1.1.1 expose their REST API key to unauthenticated users. This exposure allows attackers to create posts containing unfiltered JavaScript, resulting in stored cross-site scripting (XSS) that executes in the browsers of any visitors, including administrators.
